findings.statement: Package provenance is inconsistent: the reviewed revision, manifest current_revision and embedded review report input_revision do not identify the same frozen commit.
findings.recommendation: Adopt one frozen revision convention and align manifest current_revision, review input_revision and the actual commit under review.

findings.statement: The acceptance harness accepts arbitrary adapter output; an empty or incomplete A-01..A-12 result set without fail/pending rows could exit successfully.
findings.recommendation: Require exactly one result for every A-01..A-12 row, reject unknown/duplicate/missing rows and invalid statuses, and keep pending non-zero.

findings.statement: The rollback barrier is correctly described at contract level but still needs race-free runtime implementation, crash recording and operator-repair evidence.
findings.recommendation: Keep the residual risk open until the target runtime implements and fault-tests the in-flight barrier.

steelman.strongest_support: The L3 contract now covers independent binding uniqueness, deterministic IDs, receipt queries, reconciliation, route policy, executable fixture/schema tests and honest pending semantics.
steelman.strongest_opposition: The target runtime, durable store, real ingress guards and race-free rollback barrier are still absent; the preflight package must not be treated as runtime evidence.
